vector_memory.semantic_summary: This service class, ResponseParser, is the core data ingestion layer responsible for transforming raw, unstructured text output from an LLM into a structured Python dictionary. It specifically parses the proprietary JARVIS Plain Text Protocol, identified by 'y '____@' tokens. Its logic handles complex parsing of fields like thought, notes, and tool definitions, employing specialized sanitization routines for YAML to correct common generative model formatting errors.
